verdict.rationale: Intel's first-party developer docs treat Core Ultra Series 2 as an explicit optimization target: oneDNN and PyTorch optimizations for Core Ultra (series 2), VTune Profiler features for its client GPU and NPU, the oneAPI development stack with SYCL interop, and OpenVINO NPU device support. Copilot+ integration and a 'platform you already know' messaging point to mainstream Windows OS support. The developer guidance is heavily AI-focused, and all evidence is vendor-claimed. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of mature compiler support (e.g. named compilers or ISA tuning flags), general-purpose CPU optimization guidance beyond AI workloads, explicit Linux/OS tier-one support statements, independent or hands-on corroboration.
